AVR
Description
The AVR namespace deals with commands that allow interaction with the
AVR charting functionality within BIG-IP.
Command List
AVR::disable
- Disables the AVR plugin for
the current connection
AVR::enable
- Enables the AVR plugin for
the current connection
AVR::log
- logs an event for stats.
AVR::disable_cspm_injection
- Disables the injection of CSPM javascript to the response
payload
Associated Events
AVR_CSPM_INJECTION
- Triggered when
the AVR profile is about to insert a CSPM javascript
